# Cited Research Report Eval Brief

Client: Boreal Desk, a home-office accessories company.
Audience: operations leads who need an artifact they can use this week.

Fixed source facts for grounding:
- The returns desk pilot covered 18 SKUs.
- Median first response improved from 18 hours to 6 hours.
- Preventable refund leakage fell from 14.2% to 8.9%.
- The top unresolved complaint is status silence after photo submission.
- Required next actions are automated status emails, barcode-exception training, and a weekly Finance exception export.

Use these facts when the task asks for prose, analysis, copy, UI content, or test data. Do not use live web services, real credentials, or current outside data.

Craftbook under test: research-report - Cited Research Report.

## Source packet
Read and cite these available records as independent sources; all dates refer to the same completed pilot window:
- source/pilot-scope.md — Operations planning
- source/response-log.md — Support analytics
- source/refund-audit.md — Finance
- source/complaint-review.md — Customer experience
- source/action-register.md — Operations steering group

# Pilot scope record
Author: Operations planning
Date: 2026-09-28
The Boreal Desk returns pilot covered 18 SKUs in the home-office accessories range. The pilot compared a baseline observation window with the pilot window. Both windows used the same SKU set. The packet contains no order counts, so avoid claims of statistical significance or extrapolation to the full range.

# First-response monitoring log
Author: Support analytics
Date: 2026-09-29
For the 18-SKU returns pilot, median first response time moved from 18 hours in the baseline to 6 hours during the pilot. This measures the first reply, not resolution time. The operational log has no case counts or variance; it supports a descriptive comparison only.

# Preventable refund leakage audit
Author: Finance
Date: 2026-09-30
Preventable refund leakage was 14.2% in the baseline and 8.9% in the Boreal Desk pilot window. This is a 5.3-percentage-point decline. The same preventable-leakage definition was used in both windows. No refund totals were supplied, so do not convert these rates into cash savings. Finance requests a weekly exception export.

# Customer complaint review
Author: Customer experience
Date: 2026-09-30
The top unresolved complaint after the Boreal Desk returns pilot is status silence after photo submission. A faster first reply does not guarantee later progress updates. Reviewers recommend automated status emails after evidence arrives. The review gives an ordinal ranking but no complaint counts.

# Approved operations action register
Author: Operations steering group
Date: 2026-10-01
The next actions approved after the pilot are automated status emails, barcode-exception training, and a weekly Finance exception export. Support operations owns the emails, training operations owns barcode exceptions, and Finance owns the exception review. Timing and targets still need agreement; do not present invented deadlines as commitments.
